native_prepared_assessment: APPROVABLE: exact whole-source acceptance, sole top-level grammar classification, shared connection-local namespace, conservative ASCII name folding, restrictions within bodies/parameter expressions, immutable portal provenance and cache/state separation close the pg_dump compatibility gap without bypass.

blocking_findings.title: Indirect settings mutation can violate lexical assumptions before later pipelined SQL
evidence: Current r3 ParserGate.validate accepted UPDATE pg_catalog.pg_settings SET setting = off WHERE name = standard_conforming_strings (quoted values in executed probe). No SQL was sent to a database.
PostgreSQL16 documentation defines UPDATE pg_settings as equivalent to SET.
Spec encoding promises the invariant before forwarding later pipelined queries, while current implementation only denies known SET/set_config forms and monitors later ParameterStatus.
blocking_findings.required_change: Choose an explicit enforceable remedy before final hash approval. Recommended conservative policy rejects new Q/P after forwarding Q/E until the corresponding ReadyForQuery and intervening ParameterStatus are processed. Mark busy before forwarding and identify matching cycle so an earlier Ready cannot release it; allow Sync/Flush/COPY/cancellation progress. A pg_settings-only name blacklist is incomplete if writable aliases/rules are admitted.
blocking_findings.scope: Existing revision3 omission discovered during incremental review; still material because the all-client lexical precondition is stronger than fixed-template coverage.

implementation_acceptance_notes: Exercise real pg_dump ACL paths unchanged, native PREPARE/EXECUTE plus both cross-protocol directions, unknown names, mixed-case names, quoted/Unicode/overlong rejection, same-name server failure and stale objects.
Use grammar metadata and exact token spans for classification/name extraction; comments and string contents cannot impersonate names or statement families.

Native PREPARE received through extended Parse is not server-created until executed; optimistic bookkeeping may overapproximate only accepted provenance and must not claim backend object existence or execution success.
Test cached EXECUTE on a fresh connection and failed PREPARE followed by Execute; cache acceptance must never manufacture a local target.

If lexical synchronization is added, test a fragmented delayed ParameterStatus, stale prior ReadyForQuery, E followed by P before Sync, and unsafe pg_settings mutation followed by SQL; denied subsequent bytes must never reach backend.
formal_limits: Six new obligations establish abstract admitted provenance, native unknown-target denial, Bind reachability and cache state purity.

bodyPart is only nonempty substring existence; it does not prove PREPARE body extraction, body grammar derivation, query classification, prepared-name folding or runtime correspondence. These remain trusted adapter obligations.
